benchmark_kind: custom frozen SWE-style multi-file repair benchmark

inference.prompt_cache_policy: disabled at server startup and bound by the run environment receipt

selection: maximum public cases passed among admitted proposals; later attempt breaks an exact tie
final_solve: selected proposal passes every public F2P/P2P and every held-out F2P/P2P case
common_admission: all lanes use the same bounded payload-preserving response-envelope normalization, strict replacement schema, no-op rejection and bounded inert evaluator

lane_definitions.raw: public issue, source, tests, fixed evaluator capability declaration, common strict replacement schema and one bounded public-feedback retry
lane_definitions.retrieval: raw plus deterministic public-only retrieval from the frozen corpus; the same cards remain fixed on retry
lane_definitions.full-xnet: retrieval plus compact HCE source cards and deterministic routing; its public-feedback retry expands from one to at most three frozen cards

claim_template: On the custom preregistered XNET Blind Repair 50 set, MODEL with full XNET solved X/50 versus Y/50 raw and Z/50 with retrieval only under identical generation budgets. This is not an official SWE-bench result.
